## 更新内容

### 连接状态

- 未连接到 Cider 时，主界面不再统一显示“未在播放”，而是直接说明原因：离线或接口出错时提供“重试”，Token 无效时提供“配置连接”并直接打开连接对话框。
- 连接状态按颜色分级：连接中为灰色、已连接为绿色、Token 无效为橙色、离线或出错为红色，菜单与设置页同步显示。
- 已连接时偶发的单次超时不再让界面清空闪烁，连续失败约 3 秒才显示为断开；Token 无效立即提示。
- 播放、切歌、跳转等指令被 Cider 拒绝时，改为在封面下方短暂提示，不再覆盖连接状态。

### 背景

- 主界面封面背景模糊更强、更柔和，默认设置下不再透出封面轮廓。
- 切歌时背景交叉淡化，新封面加载完成后再过渡，不再直接跳变。跟随 Windows“动画效果”设置。
- 背景封面以小尺寸解码，减少模糊运算与内存占用。

## 安装与升级

下载 `Lyrider_1.5.1.0_x64.msix` 和 `Lyrider.cer`，仅支持 Windows 11 x64。首次安装前，将证书导入当前用户的“受信任人”存储，再安装 MSIX：

```powershell
Import-Certificate -FilePath .\Lyrider.cer -CertStoreLocation Cert:\CurrentUser\TrustedPeople
Add-AppxPackage .\Lyrider_1.5.1.0_x64.msix
```

已有版本使用同一证书签名时，可直接安装新 MSIX 升级。安装包包含 .NET、Windows App SDK 运行时和中英文资源。

## 验证

- x64 Release 构建：零错误零警告。
- 逻辑及服务测试：331/331 通过（新增 11 项连接状态测试）。
- 封面集成测试 6/6、任务栏封面集成测试 6/6 通过。
- 实机确认（深色、中文）：离线、Token 无效、指令失败提示、“配置连接”入口、已连接状态，以及 40% 与 99% 背景模糊效果。浅色主题、英文界面和切歌时的背景淡化未实机确认。
- `git diff --check` 通过。

完整变更：[v1.5.0...v1.5.1](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1)

## Changes in English

### Connection status

- When Cider is unreachable, the main window explains why instead of showing "Not Playing": Retry for offline or API errors, and Configure connection (opening the connection dialog) for a missing or invalid token.
- Connection status is color-coded: gray while connecting, green when connected, orange for an invalid token, and red when offline or failing. The menu and settings page match.
- A single timeout while connected no longer blanks the window; it switches to disconnected only after about 3 seconds of consecutive failures. An invalid token is shown immediately.
- Rejected playback, skip, and seek commands now show a brief notice below the artwork instead of overwriting the connection status.

### Backdrop

- The artwork backdrop is blurred more strongly and softly; the cover's outlines no longer show through at the default setting.
- The backdrop crossfades on track changes once the new cover has loaded, instead of cutting. Follows the Windows "Animation effects" setting.
- The backdrop cover is decoded at a small size, reducing blur work and memory.

### Installation and verification

Download `Lyrider_1.5.1.0_x64.msix` and `Lyrider.cer` for Windows 11 x64. For a first installation, import the certificate into the current user's Trusted People store using the commands above, then install the MSIX. Existing installations signed with the same certificate can upgrade directly.

The x64 Release build passed with no errors or warnings; all 331 logic/service tests and both 6-test artwork integration suites passed. Offline, invalid-token, rejected-command, configure-connection, and connected states, plus 40% and 99% backdrop blur, were checked on a running app in dark mode and Chinese. Light mode, the English interface, and the backdrop crossfade on track changes were not checked on a running app. `git diff --check` passed.

Full changelog: [v1.5.0...v1.5.1](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1)
